newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metals Ex cuts 90 pct buyback offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metals Ex cuts 90 pct buyback offer.

text.p: Metals Exploration Ltd said on Tuesday that Mid-East Minerals Ltd had sold 4.2 million or 19.9 percent of Metals Exploration's shares to clients of a London broker at A$1.39 per share.
Metals Exploration also said it had revised a previous plan to buy back up to 90 percent of its shares, reducing the offer to A$1.43 per share from A$1.46.
The earlier offer lapsed on January 30.
"It is now the intention of the Metals Ex Board to propose a revised buy-back Offer," the company said.
"The new proposal is for shareholders to receive an offer to buy-back up to 90 percent of their shares at a price of $1.43 per share, (previously $1.46 per share)," it said.
The Mid-East Minerals Ltd stake in Metals Exploration had been sold to investment clients of W.H. Ireland Ltd, a member firm of the London Stock Exchange.
Metals Ex said the revised buy-back offer document would be dispatched to shareholders in early March.
Metals Ex shares were untraded at 10.40 p.m. (2340 GMT). The stock closed unchanged at A$1.30 on Monday.
